candidate_rationale: recent_production_3col matched or beat served_features on unconditional points in six of eight position-horizon cells on the historical folds and never lost detectably; at QB year-2 served_features' appearance model scored below the training base rate. Chosen on the same folds the evaluation reports: a selection between two arms, not an independent validation.

forecast_cutoff.rule: features observed through the feature season; a year-j label trains only when feature_season + j <= last complete season
forecast_cutoff.information_through: end of the 2025 NFL season including postseason

exposure_definition: games: weeks with a weekly stat row in scope
event: appeared: >= 1 stat-row game in the season
composition: e_points_year{j} = p_appear_year{j} x e_points_year{j}_given_appear on the same event and rows; points and games are exactly 0 when absent
population: every row of the 2025 feature partition of the training file (players with >= 4 stat-row games in 2025, rostered or not)
intervals: none exported; historical bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models (fit uncertainty), not model or season uncertainty
